caption: The drawing features two rectangular objects on a plain beige background. The object at the top of the image is a closed, dark brown case with ornate, embossed patterns along its edges and a raised scene in the middle depicting three human figures seated, with one holding an open book. The scene is framed by intricate scrolling decorations. The object at the bottom is an open case of similar size and color. The interior of the open case reveals an empty oval-shaped space surrounded by a gold and pink decorative border, and the inner side of the lid contains an elongated oval panel with similar gold and pink ornamentation. The cases appear to be made of leather or a similar material, with the inside borders suggesting a metallic or painted decorative finish.
title: Portrait Case
